Name: SOUND_PARAM_ST
Description: Global sound timing settings: minimum intervals for repeated sound effects such as Counter Boost and bullet hits, and the critical hit sound delay.

Fields.Name: Counter Boost Sound Interval
Fields.Description: Minimum interval between Counter Boost sound effects when they play in a row. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Bullet Hit Sound Repeat Limit Time
Fields.Description: After a bullet hit sound plays, the time before the same sound can play again. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Bullet Hit Sound Repeat Limit Distance
Fields.Description: Distance within which the bullet hit sound repeat limit applies. In metres.

Fields.Name: Critical Hit Sound Delay
Fields.Description: Time after the effective hit indicator disappears before the critical hit UI sound plays. In seconds.
